title: Rick and Renner: The Tragedy that Shook Santa Catarina
seoTitle: Rick and Renner: Tragedy in Santa Catarina
subtitle: The accident in the Urubici Mountains marks the end of the duo that defined the 90s
excerpt: The crash of the helicopter carrying singer Rick, from the sertanejo duo Rick and Renner, in Urubici, brought the career of one of the genre's most beloved bands to an.
author: Daniele Morais
trending: onde mora renner da dupla rick e renner?
contentHtml:
The accident that claimed the life of singer Rick, from the duo Rick and Renner, occurred on the afternoon of Monday, March 21, when the Bell 430 helicopter took off from Porto Belo, on the Northern Coast, bound for São Joaquim, in the mountains. The vehicle disappeared and, on Tuesday (22), the wreckage was found in the Santa Bárbara region, in the interior of Urubici.

What Happened in the Crash

The helicopter, manufactured in 2001, had a capacity for one pilot and seven passengers. At the time of the accident, the aircraft was carrying Rick, manager Bruno Avelar, videographer Paulo Soares, pilot Antônio Roberto Nóbrega de Araújo, and copilot Leopoldo Barros Teixeira. The five bodies were recovered with the help of ropes in an operation carried out by about 40 firefighters, tracking dogs, over 10 vehicles, and thermal imaging drones. After being retrieved, the bodies were taken to the Legal Medical Institute in Florianópolis for forensic examinations.

The Helicopter and Its Registration

The Bell 430 belongs to JTA Empreendimento e Urbanismo. According to the National Civil Aviation Agency, the aircraft was properly registered, with operating certification valid until August 11, 2027. The aircraft was identified by the police as belonging to an air transportation company.

Rick and Renner: The History of the Duo

Geraldo Antônio de Carvalho, known as Rick, was born in Tocantins on December 5, 1966, and moved to Brasília at age six. He began singing in bars at nine, facing trouble with the Juvenile Court due to his young age. The duo Rick and Renner was formed in the 1980s in Brasília and began achieving success in the 1990s, prior to the explosion of the so-called sertanejo universitário. Their major hits include “Ela é demais” and “Nos bares da cidade”. Rick's partner was Ivair Reis Gonçalves, known as Renner, born in Brasília on November 19, 1971. Renner started singing rock at 14 and, at 16, became a father. The duo recorded an independent LP and, with the help of Zezé Di Camargo and Luciano, were introduced to producer Manoel Nenzinho Pinto, who led them to record their first album with Continental Records.

The Impact of the Tragedy

The accident marked the end of a career that began in the bars of Brasília and spanned over three decades. The news of Rick's passing and the death of the other passengers generated a strong reaction among fans, who remember the duo for their songs celebrating life and friendship. Rick's body was taken to the Legal Medical Institute in Florianópolis, where the forensic examination will be performed.
